correctness.rationale: Exact four-state transfer proves the local edge constraint; all trivalent root predicates are enumerated. Integer identities M^4=M^3+M and M^3h=M^2h+h imply two commuting three-term recurrences with verified 3-by-3 initial values. The cycle count has the same recurrences and a positive 3-by-3 difference seed, so two inductions yield the all-parameter strict bound. Standalone exact brute checks cover c+t<=15 and cycles up to n=15. Finite tests are independent evidence rather than the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The conjectured cycle bound is an explicit open extremal challenge for connected graphs in the initiating 2026 literature. A lollipop is a natural two-parameter connected unicyclic subclass with genuinely competing cycle and tail lengths. A full rational bivariate enumeration and a strict all-parameter inequality are structural results requiring a trivalent-root transfer and positivity, not an arbitrary small slice or a routine numeric table.
